title: Deterministic Fully-Static Whole-Binary Translation Without Heuristics
summary: A research paper presenting a deterministic, fully-static whole-binary translation system that eliminates heuristic-based approaches for translating binary executables across architectures without runtime guesswork.
problem_solved: Removes non-deterministic behavior and heuristics from binary translation, enabling reproducible and predictable cross-architecture binary execution.
why_valuable: Enables reliable binary translation for security research, legacy system emulation, and cross-platform compatibility where determinism and correctness are critical.
